text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Samples 16.0 to 16.8 s of option a. Camera held at the tighter creek framing. The SUV is sunk to its window line with a reflection and white wake curl, and drifts left across the frame past the fixed tree trunk. Right of the car a vertical pale line drops from the ledge into the water, with a lighter brown area to its right; two small pale rectangular flecks sit on the water near it. The stone ledge still spans the full width with a long near-horizontal lower edge against the water.
